Package com.egradx.audit.config

Class EgradxAuditAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.audit.config.EgradxAuditAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after={org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.jdbc.DataSourceAutoConfiguration.class,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.jdbc.DataSourceTransactionManagerAutoConfiguration.class,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.orm.jpa.HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration.class,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.transaction.TransactionAutoConfiguration.class,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.flyway.FlywayAutoConfiguration.class,EgradxObservabilityAutoConfiguration.class}) @ConditionalOnSingleCandidate(javax.sql.DataSource.class) @EnableConfigurationProperties(EgradxAuditProperties.class) public class EgradxAuditAutoConfiguration extends Object
The audit trail, in the application's own database.

Plain JDBC — no entities, no component scan, nothing registered with the application's JPA. Every bean backs off to one of the application's own. Records are written through the application's transaction manager, so that they join its transactions.
